mint.$description: Tabby brand mint. Seed #3ffcb5 sampled from the Tabby logo tile (Mobbin), pinned on tone 90 (seed tone 89). Method: Material 3 tonal palette (HCT tone = name, higher = lighter) + saturation touch on dark and light ends (hue turn up to 12 degrees toward more screen colour).

purple.$description: Tabby action purple. Seed #5b0dd9 sampled from the "Go to phone settings" button (Mobbin), pinned as tone 33. Method: Material 3 tonal palette (HCT tone = name, higher = lighter) + saturation touch on dark and light ends (hue turn up to 12 degrees toward more screen colour).

pink.$description: Tabby product accent. Seed #e260db sampled from the Pay later icon (Mobbin), pinned on tone 60 (seed tone 61). Method: Material 3 tonal palette (HCT tone = name, higher = lighter) + saturation touch on dark and light ends (hue turn up to 12 degrees toward more screen colour).

green.$description: Success. Seed #23aa5d sampled from the Money tab intro (Mobbin), pinned on tone 60 (seed tone 62). Method: Material 3 tonal palette (HCT tone = name, higher = lighter) (plain, no saturation touch: user call 2026-10-30).

red.$description: Danger. Seed #e0353d derived (no Tabby red on Mobbin), pinned on tone 50. Method: Material 3 tonal palette (HCT tone = name, higher = lighter) + saturation touch on dark and light ends (hue turn up to 12 degrees toward more screen colour).

50-a24.$description: Red 50 at 24% alpha: soft critical tint on dark surfaces (user 2026-11-05).

amber.$description: Warning. Seed #f5a524 derived (no Tabby amber on Mobbin), pinned as tone 74. Method: Material 3 tonal palette (HCT tone = name, higher = lighter) + saturation touch on dark and light ends (hue turn up to 12 degrees toward more screen colour).

grey.$description: Neutral, Material neutral tones incl. surface tones. Seed #23272c = Money tab dark card (Mobbin), pinned as tone 15. Tone 6 = Tabby dark screen (sampled #11141a). Method: Material 3 tonal palette (HCT tone = name, higher = lighter) + saturation touch on dark and light ends (hue turn up to 12 degrees toward more screen colour).

45.$description: In-between tone for tertiary text that must pass 4.5:1 on light tinted surfaces.
